comment: Sevii access, closing the loop: Bill, met again in Celio's Pokemon Center after the introduction (pokefirered CinnabarIsland/scripts.inc, CinnabarIsland_EventScript_ReturnFromSeviiIslands -- in the source this conversation happens back on Cinnabar after Bill ferries you home at the end of the first detour, and its line is what tells the player the Tri-Pass now works on the ferry; it also advances the Cinnabar scene to the value the island ferry menus read as 'Vermilion allowed'). PUW's flow differs in one recorded way: there is no separate Bill-ferried return trip (the Seagallop covers returns once the pass exists), so the line is placed where its information belongs -- with Bill on One Island, right after MeetCelio -- and the 'Vermilion in the island menus' effect is intrinsic to the ferry scripts (a pass holder has finished the detour by construction; see sevii_ferry_wiring.json). One exact label, decoded into patched/data/sevii_bank_additions.json (group CinnabarIsland, its source text file). Plays once: sevii_bill_return_noted is the once_flag, which the runner sets itself on completion.
